# netbox_owner_group (Resource)

From the official NetBox documentation:

> Owner groups can be used to group individual owners (users and/or user groups) together for the purpose of assigning ownership of objects.

## Example Usage

```terraform
resource "netbox_owner_group" "test" {
  name        = "Infrastructure Team"
  description = "Owner group for infrastructure objects"
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `name` (String)

### Optional

- `description` (String)

### Read-Only

- `id` (String) The ID of this resource.
- `member_count` (Number)
